scientific_integrity: Analytic if-and-only-if proof with critical form-core and oscillator lemmas; numerical checks are supplementary; historical uniqueness is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Isotropic real cross coupling bI, positive b and damping s>b/2; exactly the stated quadratic multiplier; no arbitrary anisotropic cross-coupling or higher-degree result.
title: A Bures–Wasserstein positivity threshold for quadratic Gaussian integral kernels
